title: Review length and spoiler ratio formulas
pdf_question: How are the review_length and spoiler_ratio features computed? Write down the formula for each.
graph_structure: Two histograms: review_length (left) and spoiler_ratio (right); gold line = worked example
formulas: review_length = sum(len(sentence_text) for sentence in review_sentences)
spoiler_ratio = k / n   if n > 0 else 0.0
k = count of sentences whose flag == 1
